"Hey, you know those clockmakers we met when we went on that trip to Earth?"

"Yeah, I remember. Why are you bringing them up now?"

"A couple o' them told me that they were always in the zone when wearing one of these gears 'round their wrist. Said it helped 'em work way faster."

"I see but… what does that have to do with the mountain of lemurian corpses behind you?"

"Well, uh… I can tell you that it works."

strings.FAITHFUL_LEADERS_PENNON_LORE:
We knew we'd never win. This planet was as hellish as it was relentless.

Many died as soon as the blast doors opened. Lizard people, giant jellyfish, constructs made of the very ground beneath our very feet. They all conspired somehow - someway - to massacre us all. We never stood a chance.

And our squad leader, that damn idiot... What was left of him was marked with the flag that led us to our demise.

Dave: "Heh... I thought that was it for a moment. Honestly, thought my heart stopped."

Listen, I know you guys probably already know a decent amount about these "slimes" but KEEP THESE THINGS IN A SEALED CHAMBER!

They may look friendly but that's just a coincidence. I've seen these things escape a containment tank just to eat the security guard in seconds over the cameras. It's not exactly a display of nature's beauty, I'll say that much.

You don't need to worry about their diet or any special needs. Place any form of organic matter in front of them and they'll consume and integrate it into their own physiology in the span of an hour. Make sure they get some sunlight, too. At least 3 hours a day. If they generate any unusual substances, send a sample over to us. We'll let you know if we find anything with our own research.

I know you guys are interested in the possible medicinal benefits these could provide but do be extra careful with them. I wouldn't be thrilled to hear you guys go the way of their meals as well.

strings.FAITHFUL_COLLECTORS_VISION_LORE:
<style=cMono>//--AUTO-TRANSCRIPTION FROM UES [Redacted] --//</style>

"So, y'ever notice Bob? The guy's got this weird knack for collecting, like, everything. Pencils, coffee mugs, even the boss' autographed posters."

"Yeah, one day, he showed up wearin' this goofy-looking doohickey."

"Doohickey... That's what you call it? The thing's alive I swear it. One day I kid y'not that thing looked back at me... Like it's analyzing me head to toe."

"Whatever it is, Bob is really protective abou' it. Says he got it from his mate Jim as some sort of partin' gift."

"Jim... Tha' the guy who got sacked on all those branches over at [REDACTED] and caused that chaos in 23-B?"

"Defini'ely not... Probably... Anyways none o' my business, ignorance is bliss. Now where's that damned screwdriver?"

[With perfect accuracy, Bob throws a screwdriver right onto the workstation from the other room]

"Cheers mate."

"I'm serious, man. It freaks me out... The guy's got more energy and precision than a caffeinated hummingbird..."

[Loud sounds of drilling, clunking and twisting metal]

"Mhm..."

"Are you listenin'?... I heard rumors about what 'appened in 23-B... And I don't want it happenin' here."

[Workshop sounds continue; sounds of objects being quickly dismantled and reassembled can be heard from the other room]

"Huh?... Oh. Yeh."

"I don't know how you're able to ignore all this. Even the cap' is unnerved by it all... thought the guy was on drugs."

[A loud crackle can be heard followed closely by the emergency lighting whirring up, then silence]

<style=cMono>//--SIGNAL LOST --//</style>

strings.FAITHFUL_APPRAISERS_EYE_LORE:
<style=cMono>//--AUTO-TRANSCRIPTION FROM UES [Redacted] --//</style>

"Tell me tha' crackle was just a blown relay."

"Negative. Cargo Bay C's on manual lockdown. Somebody tripped the inventory lasers, the floor scales, an'— somehow— the nursery heaters."

"The what?"

"Exactly."

[Distant metallic clattering. A wet popping sound can be heard every few seconds.]

"I'm not goin' back in there."

"Oh, c'mon. Bob ain't gonna hurt anybody."

"He's in the cargo bay talkin' to pallets, Gary. And every time he picks up somethin' that weird doohickey on his shoulder flashes, then one o' those little purple eggs drops outta it like it's layin' invoices."

"They're not eggs."

"They blinked at me."

"...Right. Okay. They might be eggs."

[Intercom feedback whines loudly.]

"Attention deckhands: whoever sealed Cargo Bay C, open it immediately. We've got volatile freight in there and Bob [Redacted] refuses to answer his comm."

"Cap', with respect, I think Bob's gone rogue. He lined up thirty-two signal flares by shade, weight, and what he called 'attitude.' Then that doohickey of his scanned the shelf, and now he's got half a dozen eyeball eggs starin' at the crate of nail guns."

"Maybe it's breedin'."

"Maybe don't say that."

"Well, one thing's for certain- I ain't goin' in there no matter what."

"Agreed, if that thing ever learns to talk, I'm quittin' before it starts assignin' us values."<style=cMono>

//--TRANSCRIPTION ENDS: LOCAL STORAGE CORRUPTED BY UNAUTHORIZED MANIFEST REVISION --//</style>

strings.FAITHFUL_MATTER_ACCELERATOR_LORE:
"Day 17 of making a homemade matter accelerator.

There's some good and bad news on my progress so far.

The good news is that I've finally got it working consistently enough to start testing its specs. The bad news is that I'm going to need a better camera in order to record any actual results. The one I have now is way too blurry.

Oh, I also managed to trigger my neighbor's home security system. So I should probably work on avoiding that."

strings.FAITHFUL_SURVIVOR_TECHNICIAN_DESCRIPTION:
The Technician uses her gadgets and technology to assist her in dealing powerful instances of electrifying damage.

< ! > Even if Arc cannot reach an enemy, using it on a nearby drone or turret can allow Technician to still assist in damage via Overclock.

< ! > Using Powervolt while tethered to a strong foe using Arc can be effective for dealing with fodder surrounding it.

< ! > Charge Flow can be used as both an approach or to dodge attacks when close enough to an enemy or mechanical ally.

< ! > Deploying and directing Technician's Conduits to favorable locations can be useful for whittling down approaching enemies or to use Charge Flow for extra mobility.
